## [1.27.0](https://github.com/sqzass/lustx-patches/compare/v1.26.0...v1.27.0) (2026-11-22)

### ✨ New Features

* add `Compliance.kt` to help failed patches from preventing a patched app  from being patched into a patched app ([d9dd964](https://github.com/sqzass/lustx-patches/commit/d9dd9640647f199291d7508915ab2f74eef52ed1))
* add `Unlock pro` patch for PortDroid. ([fb4268c](https://github.com/sqzass/lustx-patches/commit/fb4268c6da6e05e99d8df03bdef28a4ca7268a71))
* Alight Motion premium unlock Phase 1 (5.0.270.1002578) ([ac0e1b4](https://github.com/sqzass/lustx-patches/commit/ac0e1b45eaef938bba1bd5252fb6d5565d60f8fd))
* **PortDroid:** add support for version `1.3.0` instead of only the outdated `1.0.7`. both work, at least that ive seen. ([a3f5636](https://github.com/sqzass/lustx-patches/commit/a3f56361bc07a3f266208ddcf500f34cd60852cb))
* **PortDroid:** rewrite the `Bypass signature check` patch so it's more robust ([2e368e2](https://github.com/sqzass/lustx-patches/commit/2e368e2c4d51f6e3e43e3e150ac6f6abfef96941))

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* pin semantic-release to 25.x (peer dep conflict) ([f5b66b6](https://github.com/sqzass/lustx-patches/commit/f5b66b69c63a740924a730e95172944ccf3db5e2))
* **PortDroid:** `Unlock pro` patch works on both supported versions ([02dcad6](https://github.com/sqzass/lustx-patches/commit/02dcad68db1bafdf67de3097a4603e506d6a9712))

patches.name: Unlock premium (core)
patches.description: Forces the core account-layer membership gates on.

patches.name: Unlock premium (membership gates)
patches.description: Forces the remaining pro-gated feature checks on.

patches.name: Remove clip bumper
patches.description: Removes the Postparty logo bumper from all exports. NOTE: I SUCK AT CODING, USE *MODIFIED* CLIPS. TRIM A SECOND OR ADD A STICKER!

patches.name: Enable media sniffer
patches.description: Restores Pawxy's hidden media sniffer to the toolbar.

patches.name: Rate-us popup
patches.description: Removes or rewrites the rate-us popup text.

options.description: Prevents the rate-us dialog from ever appearing. Off = rewrite mode (change text instead of removing).
Replaces rate_app_title and rate_head. Only used if remove is off.
Replaces rate_request and rate_app_propose. Only used if remove is off.
Replaces rate_rate_now. Only used if remove is off.

patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Unlocks Pawxy premium features (VPN servers, removes paywall and upsell badges).

patches.name: Bypass signature check
patches.description: Bypasses PortDroid's signature check so the re-signed app passes validation.

patches.name: Unlock Pro
patches.description: Unlocks PortDroid Pro features (forces the pro gate and billing status).

patches.name: Unlock Pro
patches.description: Unlocks all MEGA Pro features and removes ads.

options.description: Which Pro tier to spoof. PRO III is the highest consumer tier.
